items.title: Octave Crosby Interview
items.q: I take lessons under her and I take lessons under another lady by name was Miss DeVoyne. Massey DeVoyne.

ctx.x: And she used to play in the church at the First Street Baptist Church. That's the First Street Drive. Oh, that's the first town. Yeah. And I take lessons under her and I take lessons under another lady by name was Miss DeVoyne. Massey DeVoyne. I've heard her name. She used to live on Pusha Street. Mm-hmm.
Did either one of them ever play any dance music or just…
